thread.title: Schumer-Sanders buyback block could hit big tech - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Schumer-Sanders buyback block could hit big tech - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Senate Democratic leader Charles Schumer and Sen. Bernie Sanders are calling for legislation that would prohibit companies from buying back shares unless the company pays workers a $15 per hour minimum wage with paid time off and health benefits.
If it happens, the legislation would hit tech giants including Apple ( AAPL +1.8% ) with its $239M in share buybacks in past decade, Microsoft ( MSFT +1% ) with $94M in buybacks, IBM ( IBM +0.1% ) with $93M, and Oracle ( ORCL +0.5% ) with $81.7M.
